description: This file defines the FnDispatcher class responsible for dispatching and executing various named functions within the JMESPath library, including functions like abs, avg, ceil, contains, and others. It serves as a central point for managing external function calls based on function names.

classes.name: FnDispatcher
classes.description: A class responsible for dispatching dynamic function calls based on function names, validating arguments, and executing the corresponding internal method.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of the FnDispatcher.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Allows the object to be called as a function, dispatching to the appropriate function implementation.

methods.name: fn_abs
methods.description: Calculates the absolute value of a number.

methods.name: fn_avg
methods.description: Calculates the average of a numeric array.

methods.name: fn_ceil
methods.description: Returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to a number.

methods.name: fn_contains
methods.description: Checks if a string or array contains a specified value.

methods.name: fn_ends_with
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified suffix.

methods.name: fn_floor
methods.description: Returns the largest integer less than or equal to a number.

methods.name: fn_not_null
methods.description: Returns the first argument that is not null among the provided arguments.

methods.name: fn_join
methods.description: Joins elements of an array into a string separated by a specified delimiter.

methods.name: fn_keys
methods.description: Returns the keys of an object as an array.

methods.name: fn_length
methods.description: Returns the length of a string, array, or object.

methods.name: fn_max
methods.description: Finds the maximum value in an array.

methods.name: fn_max_by
methods.description: Finds the maximum array element based on a specified expression.

methods.name: fn_min
methods.description: Finds the minimum value in an array.

methods.name: fn_min_by
methods.description: Finds the minimum array element based on a specified expression.

methods.name: fn_reverse
methods.description: Reverses an array or string.

methods.name: fn_sum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of all numbers in an array.

methods.name: fn_sort
methods.description: Sorts an array in natural order.

methods.name: fn_sort_by
methods.description: Sorts an array based on an expression applied to each element.

methods.name: fn_starts_with
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a specified prefix.

methods.name: fn_type
methods.description: Returns the type of a value.

methods.name: fn_to_string
methods.description: Converts a value to its string representation.

methods.name: fn_to_number
methods.description: Converts a value to a number if possible.

methods.name: fn_values
methods.description: Returns the values of an array or object.

methods.name: fn_merge
methods.description: Merges multiple arrays or objects into one.

methods.name: fn_to_array
methods.description: Converts a value to an array.

methods.name: fn_map
methods.description: Applies an expression to each element of an array.

methods.name: typeError
methods.description: Handles type mismatch errors during validation.

methods.name: validateArity
methods.description: Checks if the number of arguments matches the expected count.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates argument types against expected types.

methods.name: validateType
methods.description: Validates if a value matches permissible types.

methods.name: validateSeq
methods.description: Validates two values for matching types in a sequence.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Reduces an array of values to a single value using a callback function.

methods.name: wrapExpression
methods.description: Wraps an expression to validate its return type.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles calls to undefined methods, throwing an exception.
